details: ap3-foundations-ui describes itself as a security research PoC for dependency confusion and does not identify an upstream package it copies. Its `preinstall` hook runs `node index.js` during `npm install`; the script sends the package name and version, hostname, username, home directory, working directory, platform, architecture, and CI flag to `https://webhook.site/7dbd5e4e-3156-427f-b383-30c14d845587`. The npm account vikkuthetester22 published it on 2026-10-12.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code

files.note: Executed by the preinstall script of ap3-foundations-ui@99.0.1.
